5. Amount of advance.(i) Only one advance shall be sanctioned to the Government servant during his/ her entire service.
- (ii) The maximum amount of advance shall be:
- (a) 34 months' basic pay subject to a maximum of ~ 25 lakhs only (Rupees Twenty-five lakhs), or cost of the house/flat, or the amount according to repaying capacity, whichever is the least for construction/purchase of new house/flat.
